(A) Build the Markovian reduction of the relic kernel per the workshop T-eq.5 construction (T1-C4; diagonal + anomalous sectors); grade it under t→−t by functional antisymmetrization in H at fixed (q, a): F_± = (F(+H) ± F(−H))/2 on the tail grid; c_odd/c_even from the graded split at the occupation-weighted tail reference |H|. (B) Verification-assert of the analytic dilution-window result: assert max(q_dec) < 1.857 on the tail; report realized min/max of 3·p_local with p_local = 1/(1 + q_dec) (q_dec from the S99 backbone arr_q_primary_t, arr_q_bare_t as cross-check). (C) Derive the backbone clock normalization γ = dt/dτ from substrate inputs — the q-channel inertia χ_I via the kernel-reactive route (reactive/even part of the Markovian-reduced kernel at zero secular frequency); this FIXES the disclosed s97 t_relax = 1.0 unit freedom ('sets units; cancels in slope', s97 L361); γ ≡ ω_q^{τ}/ω_q^{phys} with ω_q^{phys} = √(k_curv/χ_I). Convert ω_q = 59.888 τ⁻¹ and the pair band 2E_k = 2√(λ_k² + q) to the common clock; compute Δ_res = min_k |2E_k − ω_q^{phys}|/ω_q^{phys} over the OCCUPATION-WEIGHTED support of {n_k, σ_k} (s97 npz keys w_n / n_k_gge; support = modes with n·w ≥ 1e-6·max(n·w)); report band edges from BOTH the 992-mode working set AND the full L_max=12 cache (band-top caveat, A-V2 R1); report any tail crossing 2E_k(q(τ)) = ω_q^{phys}; report measured parametric depth h_par = q_osc/(λ_min² + q̄) (tail ringing amplitude at ω_q, from the s100a driven-IC arrays); report Δt(window) vs t_therm ≈ 6 M_KK⁻¹. Post-processing on existing caches; the γ/χ_I derivation is the one new element."
  producing_script: "computations/session-101/s101_w4_qeq_relic_oddfloor.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:

  form: "PASS ⟺ [|c_odd|/|c_even| ≤ 1e-3] ∧ [max(q_dec)_tail < 1.857] ∧ [Δ_res ≥ max(0.1, 5·h_par/4) ∧ no tail crossing 2E_k(q(τ)) = ω_q^{phys}] ∧ [Δt(window) < t_therm OR documented thermalized hand-off per (d5) double-lock]"

The 1e-3 odd-floor and the max(0.1, 5·h_par/4) Δ_res guard are workshop-negotiated pre-compute pins (two-sided agreed / D-2 drafted form, landing-list (iv) at :763 + :766) — BINDING, not re-derived."

# (7) substitution_chain
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "The relic sector admits NO secular odd-in-H force above the 1e-3 floor off-resonance;
            the unique surviving odd channel is parametric rectification at 2E_k ≈ ω_q."

    Definition 1: t→−t grading: a(t) → a(−t) ⇒ H ≡ ȧ/a → −H (H is t-odd); q, a, and
                  E_k(q, a) = √(λ_k² + q) are t-even. [workshop clause (b): equilibrium T, s
                  are t-odd; all gradient ratios Ḣ/H², Ḧ/H³, … are even]
    Definition 2: Markovian reduction: F_relic(q, a, H) = Σ_n c_n(q, a)·H^n — the secular
                  (phase-averaged over the gapped pair band 2E_k ≥ 2λ_min = 1.639 M_KK)
                  effective force on the q-channel; T-eq.5 construction (T1-C4), diagonal +
                  anomalous sectors.
    Definition 3: graded split by antisymmetrization at fixed (q, a):
                  F_± = (F(+H) ± F(−H))/2;  c_even ← F_+, c_odd ← F_− at the
                  occupation-weighted tail reference |H|.

    Substitute:  clause (d1): at adiabatic order ZERO, F_GGE = −Σ_k n_k ∂_q E_k(q, a) is
                 functionally H-independent at fixed (q, a) [frozen occupations; diabatic
                 transit-freeze R_therm = 5251.82] ⇒ contributes ONLY to c_even (n = 0).

    Simplify:    first-order response lag (∝ Ḣ/ω_q², even by Definition 1) and on-band
                 friction δΓ (present only if ω_q lies ON the pair band) are even-graded at
                 secular order off-resonance [constructive decomposition T1-C4/T2; the bath is
                 frequency-modulated only — Berry-flat, B = 0 exact for the number sector;
                 squeeze-phase leakage ≤ 1.2%, dephased at pair frequencies ≥ 2λ_min with
                 ~1/√59.8 incoherent stacking]
                 ⇒ the only candidate secular odd channel is parametric rectification at
                 2E_k ≈ ω_q.

    Canonical form: OFF-resonance (Δ_res above guard): |c_odd|/|c_even| is suppressed below
                    1e-3 (the odd-floor). ON-resonance (a tail crossing 2E_k(q(τ)) = ω_q^{phys}
                    exists): the suppression argument is VOID — pre-registered FAIL.

    Direction:   the gate MEASURES the realized graded ratio and the resonance geometry under
                 the substrate-derived clock γ. Odd-floor + no-crossing CONFIRMS relic clause
                 (d) at argument-grade; a crossing or a floor violation DEMOTES it
                 (argument-grade → coincidence-bounded).

    Conclusion:  the (d5) pincer couples the asserts through the single clock normalization γ:
                 holding ω_q below the pair band throughout the tail forces Δt(window) ≳ t_therm
                 (4.8–9.5 vs ≈ 6 M_KK⁻¹) — the below-band + frozen corner is self-inconsistent;
                 frozen ⟹ (d1)–(d4) close it; thermalized ⟹ double-locked under clauses (a)–(c)
                 + (d2); only the transient crossover window escapes both, and it is bounded
                 by t_therm — hence the duration conjunct.

## §W4-3. S101-W0-BRANCH-IV-EVALUATOR

Canonical BINDING spec: `sessions/session-100b/session-100b-w1-workingpaper.md:373–374` (gate-level CF block) + `:399–403` (WP-level mirror) + `session-100b-campaign-closeout-synthesis.md:165–170` (§V.4, incl. the binding DR3 sequencing note). Thresholds transcribed verbatim.

**Structure decision (planner's call, documented per the spec's "your call" clause)**: ONE gate with TWO sequenced legs in a single producing script — leg 1 = derivation (recombination map + §(iv-bis) algebraic-distance theorem + consumption-layer declaration + the HARD admissibility check), leg 2 = the CAC spread re-run on the derived evaluator. Rationale: the admissibility clause is a hard precondition INSIDE the same gate; a two-block split would manufacture an upstream-blocked mechanical closure for the second block whenever leg 1 fails (a forward-pinned-follow-up structure inside one wave), which `mechanical-closure-discipline.md` disfavors when single-script sequencing suffices. Leg-1 failure routes the composite to the pre-registered INFO-(derivation-inadmissible) shape; leg 2 then does not execute and the verdict says so honestly.

hypothesis: "Applying the S62 BCS anomalous-self-energy screening (Σ_anom(q² = M_KK²) correction to g_3(M_KK); THRESHOLD-62 / HIGGS-BCS-THRESHOLD-62 — the documented mechanism closing m_H 134 → ~125, applied to date to m_H ONLY, never to M₀^{sector}) to the |s(h)|²-anchored M₀^{sector} shrinks the inherited residual band (currently δM₀/M₀ ∈ [+5.356%, +7.114%], exact rationals 67/1251, 89/1251) toward 0 IN STEP with the m_H closure — because M₀ inherits the anchor at LINEAR first power (S100a-M0-MH-INHERITANCE), the screening that closes m_H transfers to M₀ at first power."

method:
  description: "THREE-conjunct structure (the genuine contingencies, avoiding PASS-by-construction). (1) δ_BCS^solve: re-run the S62 2-loop machinery (s62_higgs_bcs_threshold.py lineage: g_3^eff(M_KK) = g_3(M_KK)·(1 − δ_BCS); λ_CCM(M_KK) = (4/3)·g_3eff²·ratio_gilkey; 2-loop RG down to M_Z; m_H = √(2λ)·v_ew) and root-solve m_H^scr(δ) = m_H_obs = 125.1 on the pre-existing scan range δ ∈ [0, 0.5] — δ_BCS^solve must EXIST and be UNIQUE there. (2) δ-consistency: |δ_BCS^solve − 0.07| ≤ 0.03 — the screening NEEDED is the screening the documented BCS enhanced estimate PROVIDES (THRESHOLD-62's physical content; a root far from 0.07 means the m_H closure is not attributable to the BCS mechanism even if a root exists). (3) Screened band, PRIMARY route (m_H-level first-power transfer — this IS the S100a-measured LINEAR-first-power inheritance law): r_a^scr = (m_H^scr,a − m_H_obs)/m_H_obs with m_H^scr,a = m_H^scr,RG(δ_solve)·(m_H_a/m_H_tree) for anchors a ∈ {KK: 131.8, tree: 134.0}; note m_H^scr,RG(δ_solve) = 125.1 by construction ⇒ r_tree^scr = 0 BY CALIBRATION (disclosed: not a finding) and r_KK^scr = m_H_KK/m_H_tree − 1 = −22/1340 = −11/670 = −1.6418% EXACT under first-power transfer — the discriminating content is conjuncts (1)+(2), the per-anchor monotonicity, and the SECONDARY-route convergence. SECONDARY route (report-only convention-sensitivity diagnostic, pre-registered): apply δ_solve at the KK-corrected boundary (λ_KK-boundary = (4/3)·g_3eff²·ratio_gilkey·(131.8/134.0)²), run the same 2-loop RG down, report r_KK^scr,RG and the PRIMARY-vs-SECONDARY deviation; flag CONVENTION-SENSITIVE in the value string if |r_KK^scr,PRIM − r_KK^scr,RG| > 0.010 absolute. Report both unscreened exact rationals alongside."
  producing_script: "computations/session-101/s101_w4_m0_bcs_screening.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "inequality"
  form: "PASS ⟺ [δ_BCS^solve exists, unique in [0, 0.5]] ∧ [|δ_BCS^solve − 0.07| ≤ 0.03] ∧ [|r_a^scr| < |r_a^unscr| for BOTH anchors a ∈ {KK, tree}] ∧ [max_a |r_a^scr| ≤ 0.020 on the PRIMARY route]"

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "0.020 absolute on max_a |r_a^scr| (FROZEN AT THIS PLAN-FREEZE per the binding CF's delegation); INFO ceiling 0.035; δ-consistency window ±0.03 about 0.07"
  direction: "<="

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: "Threshold derivation (frozen now): the unscreened band midpoint is 78/1251 = 6.235% with inter-anchor half-spread 11/1251 = 0.879% — the component a COMMON screening cannot remove (the anchors differ by the S64 KK-threshold correction, not by screening). Under exact first-power tree-calibrated transfer the screened band is [−11/670, 0] = [−1.6418%, 0] EXACT (r_KK^scr = 131.8/134 − 1, independent of m_H_obs). Ceiling 0.020 = the analytic expected 1.642% + 0.36% margin for RG-transfer nonlinearity (the screening enters the boundary as λ ∝ g²(1−δ)², then runs 2-loop; the SECONDARY route prices this). The expected PASS value sits at 82% of the ceiling — a genuine test, not vacuous-margin. INFO ceiling 0.035 ≈ midpoint-shrink factor < 1.8× (fails 'in step': the m_H closure factor is ≳ 5×) while still confirming direction."

# (4) reachable_rationals

  anchors_pin: "m_H_FW_tree = 134.0 (theorem A10); m_H_FW_KK_threshold = 131.8 (KK-THRESHOLD-64); m_H_obs = 125.1; unscreened band 67/1251, 89/1251 EXACT from s100a_m0_mh_inheritance.npz"
  calibration_disclosure: "r_tree^scr = 0 BY CALIBRATION under the PRIMARY route (m_H_obs used once, on the tree anchor) — disclosed in WP + value string; the gate's discriminating content = root existence + δ-consistency + KK-anchor screened residual + monotonicity + SECONDARY-route convergence"

# (7) substitution_chain
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim (direction, MANDATORY per the source CF): "The screened M₀ residual band shrinks
           toward 0 in step with the m_H closure."

    Definition 1: r_a ≡ δM₀/M₀ at anchor a — the M₀^{sector} residual inherited LINEARLY at
                  first power through the SHARED |s(h)|² fiber-embedding anchor
                  [S100a-M0-MH-INHERITANCE, audit d00bbb37…: inheritance = LINEAR-first-power;
                  band_conditional = [+5.356%, +7.114%]; band_if_independent = 0]:
                  r_KK = (131.8 − 125.1)/125.1 = 6.7/125.1 = 67/1251 = +5.356% EXACT
                  r_tree = (134.0 − 125.1)/125.1 = 8.9/125.1 = 89/1251 = +7.114% EXACT
    Definition 2: S62 screening: g_3^eff(M_KK) = g_3(M_KK)·(1 − δ_BCS); boundary
                  λ_CCM = (4/3)·g_3eff²·ratio_gilkey; 2-loop RG down; m_H^scr = √(2λ_IR)·v_ew.
                  m_H^scr(δ) is MONOTONE DECREASING in δ over [0, 0.5] (smaller g_3eff ⇒
                  smaller boundary λ ⇒ smaller m_H — established by the S62 sensitivity scan;
                  re-verified in-gate on the recomputed scan).
    Definition 3: first-power transfer (the measured inheritance law): the screened anchor
                  maps m_H_a → m_H^scr,a = m_H^scr,RG(δ)·(m_H_a/m_H_tree), and
                  r_a^scr = (m_H^scr,a − m_H_obs)/m_H_obs.

    Substitute:  r_a^scr = (m_H_a·(1 + δ_eff) − m_H_obs)/m_H_obs   with
                 1 + δ_eff ≡ m_H^scr,RG(δ)/m_H_tree, δ_eff < 0 for δ > 0 (Definition 2
                 monotonicity).

    Simplify:    r_a^scr = (m_H_a − m_H_obs)/m_H_obs + δ_eff·(m_H_a/m_H_obs)
                 = r_a + δ_eff·(m_H_a/m_H_obs)
                 [one algebra step: split the numerator]

    Canonical form: r_a^scr = r_a − |δ_eff|·(m_H_a/m_H_obs)   for δ > 0.

    Direction:   |δ_eff|·(m_H_a/m_H_obs) > 0 for both anchors ⇒ BOTH band members move DOWN
                 (toward and through 0 from above). At δ = δ_BCS^solve (tree calibration):
                 r_tree^scr = 0 exactly, r_KK^scr = 131.8/134 − 1 = −11/670 = −1.6418% exact ⇒
                 the band [+5.356%, +7.114%] → [−1.642%, 0]: max|r| drops 7.114% → 1.642%
                 (factor 4.33 on the worst member; midpoint 6.235% → 0.821%, factor 7.6) —
                 "in step" with the m_H closure (134 → 125.1, residual ratio ≳ 5× reduction).
                 The irreducible remnant is the inter-anchor half-spread 11/1251 = 0.879%
                 (KK-threshold correction, not a screening effect) — the screened band CANNOT
                 close below the spread the anchors carry; the 0.020 ceiling respects this.

    Conclusion:  sign_verdict keys on per-anchor monotone shrink (|r_a^scr| < |r_a^unscr| for
                 BOTH anchors); magnitude_verdict on max_a |r_a^scr| vs 0.020/0.035; emit the
                 schema-v2 3-tuple row. Mnemonic-vs-exact discipline: all band values carried
                 as exact rationals (67/1251, 89/1251, −11/670) alongside floats — no
                 round-figure substitution in the registry-bound numbers.

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: "δ_BCS^solve exists/unique in [0, 0.5] AND |δ_BCS^solve − 0.07| ≤ 0.03 AND both anchors shrink monotonically AND max_a |r_a^scr| ≤ 0.020 (PRIMARY route) — the S62 BCS screening mechanism transfers to M₀^{sector} in step with the m_H closure; the M₀ absolute normalization tightens from a [+5.4%, +7.1%] inherited residual to a ≤ 2% screened band whose remnant is the KK-threshold inter-anchor spread; capstone §7 honest-scope row updates (mack)."
FAIL_meaning: "No root δ_BCS^solve in [0, 0.5] (the recomputed machinery cannot close m_H — machinery-drift alarm vs S62) OR monotonicity fails for either anchor (screening moves the M₀ residual AWAY from 0 — the inheritance law and the screening transfer are incompatible) OR max_a |r_a^scr| > 0.035 — the m_H closure mechanism does NOT transfer to M₀ in step; the shared-anchor first-power picture breaks at the screening level; the capstone row keeps the unscreened band with the non-transfer documented."
INFO_meaning: "Direction confirmed (monotone shrink, root exists) BUT EITHER 0.020 < max_a |r_a^scr| ≤ 0.035 (partial closure — shrinks, not in step), OR |δ_BCS^solve − 0.07| > 0.03 (the needed screening is not the documented BCS-provided screening — the closure works numerically but its BCS attribution weakens), OR the CONVENTION-SENSITIVE flag fires (PRIMARY vs SECONDARY routes differ > 0.010 — transfer-convention dependence dominates the verdict; documented, routes to a transfer-convention derivation CF)."

# ---- Effort + framing ----
effort:
  files_created:
    - "computations/session-101/s101_w4_m0_bcs_screening.py"
    - "computations/session-101/s101_w4_m0_bcs_screening.npz"
    - "computations/session-101/s101_w4_m0_bcs_screening.png"
  estimated_time: "~1 gate (re-run of cached S62 2-loop machinery + root-solve + exact-rational transfer algebra)"

substrate_framing: |
  PARTICLE. M₀^{sector} IS a fiber-excitation mass normalization — its absolute scale is
  anchored through the |s(h)|² fiber-embedding amplitude it SHARES with the Higgs mode (the
  transverse oscillation of the fiber embedding), which is why it inherits the m_H residual at
  linear first power. The BCS condensate is the substrate's own pairing structure screening its
  own gauge moment: Σ_anom(q² = M_KK²) renormalizes g_3(M_KK), the fourth-spectral-moment
  (a₄-channel) coupling, and the question this gate prices is whether the substrate applies
  that screening COHERENTLY across everything the |s(h)|² anchor normalizes — m_H AND M₀ — or
  whether the m_H closure was channel-specific. The arrow flows BCS pairing (BdG screening
  fractions δa₂/a₂, δa₄/a₄) → g_3^eff(M_KK) → boundary λ_CCM → 2-loop RG → screened anchor →
  first-power M₀ residual. A PASS is the substrate exhibiting one screening law across two
  observables; a FAIL maps where the shared-anchor picture ends. Nothing here is a particle
  acquiring mass IN a Higgs field container — the masses ARE eigenvalue-spectrum normalizations
  of the one fiber embedding.

## Wave 4 → Downstream Decision Point

Wave 4 feeds no other Wave-4 gate (all five are mutually independent; W4-1 and W4-2 are LOGICALLY INDEPENDENT by construction — disjoint quantifier ranges, both run, neither pre-judges the other, per the workshop landing-list (v)). Downstream routing by verdict pattern:

**After W4-1 (S101-W1-QEQ-SELFCONS)**:
- PASS (clean, slope_amp confirms q_amp ∝ |H|) → the n = 2 tracking law's slope-1 leg is DERIVED; the S100b-X C10 n_eff triangle tag's physical-route member activates at n = 2; capstone §8.5 conditionality locus resolves (route to capstone designated writer; capstone-hygiene Q3/Q4 at session close); the H-parity clause-(f) carve-out is REALIZED (cite in the Wave-6 Stage-1 registration's clause-(f) status note).
- PASS with NEW-AMPLITUDE-ANOMALY flag (slope 1 realized NOT through the amplitude law) → 4-field S102 gate spec for the anomaly goes in the WP CF block (annotation ii, BINDING).
- FAIL → the last dynamical route to unforced n = 2 closes; tracking law irreducibly closure-conditional; capstone §8.5 stays OPEN with strengthened wording (designated writer).
- INFO → refinement ladder = Volovik Paper 35 §V two-component exchange blueprint; 4-field S102 CF in the WP block.

**After W4-2 (S101-W1-QEQ-RELIC-ODDFLOOR)**:
- PASS → relic clause (d) confirmed argument-grade; the Wave-6 `S101-HPARITY-STAGE1-REGISTRATION` proceeds with the frozen Stage-0 text unamended; S102 Stage-2 dispatch cleared on this leg.
- FAIL → relic clause (d) DEMOTED argument-grade → coincidence-bounded; the Stage-1 entry text is AMENDED BEFORE any Stage-2 dispatch (BINDING workshop routing). If Wave 6 registers before this FAIL lands, the amendment is an in-session designated-writer fix (housekeeping §A) — never deferred past the S102 Stage-2 dispatch.
- INFO (near-resonant or crossover-window, as pre-registered) → clause (d) stays argument-grade WITH the documented qualifier; the qualifier text rides into the Stage-1 entry.

**After W4-3 (S101-W0-BRANCH-IV-EVALUATOR)**:
- PASS → Row #1 SECONDARY stability-UNVERIFIED caveat lifts (mack sole-writer); DR3 reversal protocol footing restored; consider `w0_FW_R842` stability-status annotation in canonical_constants PROVENANCE (write-order Step 2, in-session if unambiguous).
- INFO (spread marginal OR derivation-inadmissible) → caveat persists, sharpened with the realized numbers; if inadmissible, branch-iv remains without a principled evaluator and the DR3-readiness item stays open AHEAD of the ~2027 data (re-queue with the recorded candidate forms).
- FAIL (spread > 0.050 on an admissible map) → branch-iv −0.842454 confirmed L-anchored artifact; Row #1 SECONDARY caveat HARDENS (mack); subject to the §(iv-bis) clause-(iii) informativeness declaration (a fired lock test scopes the FAIL to the surrogate and requires a canonical-evaluation gate instead).

**After W4-4 (S101-H0-PROPER-A2)** — fires on ANY landing: Row #81's value cell re-pins to the gate output via mack-cosmic-bridge (sole-writer, canonical write-order Step 3; the four-surface batch slot in Wave 6's mack dispatch is the natural carrier if the gate lands before it, else an in-session mack dispatch at wave close). PASS additionally lifts the NON-PROMOTION-BY-HELD-NUMBER tag; INFO re-pins the row to "map established, magnitude deferred" with the map cited; FAIL appends the FAIL verbatim next to the retained BAYESIAN-H0-60 lineage.

**After W4-5 (S101-M0-BCS-SCREENING)** — on landing: capstone §7 honest-scope M₀ row update routes to mack-cosmic-bridge (sole-writer); capstone-hygiene 5-question gate runs at session close (Q3 status change + Q4 prose-vs-ledger routing).

**Cross-wave coupling**: W4-2's verdict is consumed by Wave 6 (`S101-HPARITY-STAGE1-REGISTRATION`) per the FAIL/INFO routings above. W4-1's verdict status is CITED by the same registration (clause-(f) carve-out status) but does not amend the frozen Stage-0 text. No other wave consumes Wave-4 outputs this session.
